title: SENIOR PERFORMANCE MARKETING (US/EU MARKET)
subtitle: Hiring Performance Marketing Global - Full-time · Onsite, Ho Chi Minh City
body:
## **I. GENERAL INTRODUCTION**

PATI Group is targeting **20x growth within one year**. We operate D2C e-commerce brands in international markets, and **Paid Traffic is one of the three engines** driving that goal.

This role owns the budget and scales the numbers. You will not be buried in manual work - provided you make full use of our AI ecosystem.

PATI runs on three principles: **Learning Culture - AI First - Discipline**, with a focus on High Performance.

## **II. JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are not looking for someone to operate ad accounts on instruction. We are looking for someone to own a budget and answer for the numbers it produces.

**Run and optimise US/EU budgets**

- Plan, launch and optimise Meta / Google / TikTok campaigns for our brands in the US and European markets

- Own ROAS, CAC and LTV for the budget assigned to you

- Decide daily what to cut, hold or scale, based on the data

**Read creative through data**

- Analyse why an ad wins or loses, then brief the next round of tests on that conclusion

- Work directly with our in-house Creative team to produce new variations - you do not wait for a brief from above

**Build systems, not just run tasks**

- Standardise testing protocols, naming conventions and measurement so the next person can build on your work

- Apply AI to reporting and analysis to shorten the time from data to decision

## **III. JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**Required**

- **Discipline and self-management:** you do the right work, on time, and keep your commitments without being chased

- **Active self-learning:** when something new comes up, you figure it out and get it working on your own

- **Numerical and logical thinking:** you read a number and understand the problem; you decide on data, not instinct

- **English at IELTS 6.5 or above:** you read primary sources and work with US/EU markets daily

- Fluent in Meta and Google Ads Manager, able to read performance at both account and campaign level

**Preferred**

- You have **personally** run large ad budgets and been accountable for revenue or profit - not simply executed instructions

- Experience in US/EU markets, or in D2C / E-commerce

- You use AI to work faster. Better still, you can build AI Agents to take over manual work

## **IV. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

### **Income**

- Base salary **from 25,000,000 VND**, negotiable based on demonstrated capability after the interview

- Performance bonus triggered by **the ROAS you achieve and the LTV you sustain** - not by subjective assessment

- PATI benefits package aligned to your level

### **Tools and working environment**

PATI has built a technology ecosystem to multiply your output:

- **AdVault** - the full video production pipeline packaged into AI Agents under human direction: research, strategic analysis, ideation, briefing, video assembly

- **Creative Portal** - manages the video production team end to end: brief creation, job assignment, quality review, and creative performance measurement

- **AI Portal** - our Company OS. The hub where everyone at PATI learns, uses and shares AI natively, every day

And you will be the next person to contribute to this ecosystem.

### **Training and progression**

- **First 30 days:** the Performance Lead works alongside you on every major decision. From week three you run independently, with weekly 1-on-1 reviews against a clear set of criteria - you know exactly where you stand, without waiting for an annual review

- Internal courses on Gitiho · AI Academy · weekly AI Sharing every Friday

- **6 months:** running an EU market independently · **12 months:** owning multiple markets · **24 months:** able to own the P&L of a business unit

## **V. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

**Hiring process**

- Apply with your CV and portfolio, plus a short description of one ad account you have owned - budget size, results, and one cut-or-scale decision you made yourself

- An 8-minute assessment

- Technical interview

**Response commitment:** we reply within **48 hours** at every stage, whether you move forward or not. The full process takes no more than 7 working days.

**Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 8:30 - 17:30. Saturday morning 8:00 - 12:00 (paid as a full day).

**Location:** PATI Group office - Phu My Hung, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City.
